findings.evidence: kernel/rust/xpmem_helpers.rs:5470-5504 logs page-table clear errors, then unrefs the memobj, erases/frees the range and returns success; xpmem_vm_munmap_bridge at 1596-1605 finishes unconditionally.
findings.required_authority: Preserve typed clear status plus range/backing ownership through the caller before any pending inventory can drain.

findings.evidence: kernel/mem.c remote flush waits for counters but exposes no timeout/transaction generation; the public wrapper discards the result.
findings.required_authority: Retain address-buffer lifetime, generation and late-interrupt ownership while reconciling partial page-table mutation with failure rollback.

findings.evidence: kernel/xpmem.c:8513-8567 holds memory_range_lock; kernel/rust/lock_helpers.rs:138-169 disables preemption but leaves IRQs enabled.
findings.required_authority: Specify a short IRQ-safe pending lease and lock order that never spans remote shootdown or deadlocks reciprocal interrupts.

findings.evidence: phys_to_page unlocks before returning a raw descriptor pointer; final page unmap can remove hash membership; VM refcount/release supplies no restart or incarnation generation and no quarantine owner.
findings.required_authority: Generation-bearing descriptor/VM pin acquisition under hash locking plus explicit final-release/quarantine handoff.

findings.evidence: The Rust model rejects valid sentinel rings, vectors carry names/expected values only, the C reference constructs every case with count zero, and the Python harness checks strings.
findings.required_authority: Correct executable Rust/C constructors and compare real state transitions before requesting reference-equivalence credit.

smallest_prerequisite_packet: A source-bound lifecycle/clear-authority design covering descriptor allocation/removal/destruction, VM creation/final release, XPMEM partial-clear error retention, late-TLB completion lifetime and quarantine ownership across OS destruction. It must specify generation allocation/exhaustion, pin acquisition under hash locking, IRQ-safe short critical sections, complete lock order and teardown/recovery handoff.
